project.name: treetracker-field-data
project.description: Field data service that owns the raw tree tracking data that the Treetracker app uploads: raw captures, sessions, tracks, device configurations, and wallet registrations. A layered Express service (routes, handlers, services, models, repositories) over PostgreSQL, which also writes the legacy tables.

nodes.name: Raw Capture Ingestion
nodes.summary: Receives tree photo captures that the Treetracker app uploads and stores them in the field_data raw_capture table with status 'unprocessed'. Each capture belongs to an existing session and gets reference_id set to the id of a mirrored row in the legacy trees table. The domain also lists, reads, and rejects captures through the /raw-captures routes.

businessRules: POST /raw-captures requires a uuid id and session_id, lat in -90..90, lon in -180..180, a URI image_url, and an ISO captured_at (rawCaptureSchema, unknown keys rejected).
The handler deletes extra_attributes from the body before validation, because the mobile app does not send them yet; so no tree_attributes rows come from the API.
The handler sets each rotation_matrix entry below 0.001 to 0 before validation.
A capture whose session_id is not stored yet fails with HTTP 409 'has yet to be created, kindly retry later'.
Creation is idempotent on raw_capture.id: an existing id returns the stored capture with 200, a new id is inserted with status 'unprocessed' and returns 201.
PATCH /raw-captures/:raw_capture_id/reject requires rejection_reason and an Authorization header (422 'legacy authorization header needed' when missing); organization_id is an optional integer.
The legacy admin API call must succeed before the capture is set to status 'rejected'.
POST and PATCH requests without Content-Type application/json fail with HTTP 415.
crossDomainInteractions: Reads the session (with wallet and device_identifier joins) from Session & Track Tracking and fails with 409 when it is missing.
Uses Legacy Database Bridging to write the legacy trees row whose id becomes raw_capture.reference_id.
Uses Legacy Database Bridging (LegacyAPIService) to reject the legacy tree through the admin API.
List and single reads join session, wallet_registration and device_configuration to return organization_id, wallet, grower_account_id, user_photo_url and device_identifier.

nodes.name: Upload Raw Capture
nodes.summary: Stores one tree capture from the Treetracker app: it checks the session, mirrors the capture into the legacy trees table, then inserts the raw_capture row with reference_id set to the legacy tree id. It returns 201 for a new capture or 200 for an existing id.

nodes.name: Enforce JSON content type
nodes.summary: The app-level middleware rejects a POST whose content-type header is not exactly application/json with HttpError 415 'Invalid content type. API only supports application/json'.

nodes.name: Normalize upload body
nodes.summary: rawCapturePost deletes req.body.extra_attributes (not yet implemented on the mobile side) and sets each rotation_matrix entry below 0.001 to 0.

nodes.name: Validate capture with rawCaptureSchema
nodes.summary: Joi validates the body with abortEarly false: uuid id and session_id, lat -90..90, lon -180..180, URI image_url, ISO captured_at, nullable gps_accuracy, step counts, rotation_matrix and note, optional bulk_pack_file_name, no unknown keys. Failures become HTTP 422 through errorHandler.

nodes.name: Require existing session
nodes.summary: RawCaptureService.createRawCapture loads the session through SessionModel.getSessionById (joined with wallet_registration and device_configuration) and throws HttpError 409 when no session with session_id exists yet.

nodes.name: Mirror capture into legacy trees
nodes.summary: In a LegacySession transaction, LegacyTree.legacyTree builds a trees row from the session and capture fields (the capture id wins over the session id), and createTreesInLegacyDB reuses or inserts the legacy tree.

nodes.name: Insert raw capture idempotently
nodes.summary: In a field data transaction, RawCapture.createRawCapture returns the stored capture with status 200 when raw_capture.id exists; otherwise it inserts the row with reference_id = legacy tree id, status 'unprocessed', and new created_at and updated_at, and returns 201.

nodes.name: Commit or roll back both databases
nodes.summary: The service commits the field data transaction first and the legacy transaction second. On any error it rolls back whichever transaction is still open and rethrows; this is two separate transactions, not a distributed commit.

nodes.name: Respond with capture and status
nodes.summary: rawCapturePost sends the capture with the status from the service: 201 for a new row, 200 for a repeated id.

nodes.name: Reject Raw Capture
nodes.summary: Rejects a capture in both systems: it patches the mirrored legacy tree through the legacy admin API with approved false and active false, then sets raw_capture.status to 'rejected' with the rejection_reason.

nodes.name: Validate rejection request
nodes.summary: rawCaptureRejectPatch validates the body with rawCaptureRejectionSchema (required rejection_reason string, optional integer organization_id) and the path with rawCaptureIdParamSchema (uuid raw_capture_id).

nodes.name: Require legacy authorization header
nodes.summary: The handler reads req.headers.authorization and throws HttpError 422 'legacy authorization header needed' when it is missing, because the header is forwarded to the legacy admin API.

nodes.name: Load legacy tree reference
nodes.summary: RawCaptureService.rejectRawCapture begins a field data transaction, reads the capture by id and takes reference_id as the legacy tree id.

nodes.name: Reject tree in legacy admin API
nodes.summary: LegacyAPIService.rejectLegacyTree sends an axios PATCH to TREETRACKER_LEGACY_API_URL/api/[organization/<organization_id>/]trees/<id> with approved false, active false and rejectionReason, with the caller's authorization header.

nodes.name: Mark capture rejected
nodes.summary: RawCapture.rejectRawCapture updates the raw_capture row to status 'rejected' with rejection_reason and a new updated_at, and returns the earlier read capture merged with these fields.

nodes.name: Commit or roll back rejection
nodes.summary: The service commits the field data transaction and returns the updated capture; on any error it rolls back the open transaction and rethrows. The legacy PATCH is not undone when the later update fails.

nodes.name: Map admin API errors
nodes.summary: errorHandler turns an Axios error from the legacy admin API into HTTP 500 with the upstream error message, and logs the microservice url and request data.

nodes.name: List Raw Captures
nodes.summary: Returns a page of raw captures, newest first, filtered by status or bulk_pack_file_name, with a total count and prev/next links.

nodes.name: Validate list query
nodes.summary: rawCaptureGetQuerySchema allows only offset (>= 0), limit (> 0), status ('unprocessed', 'approved', 'rejected') and bulk_pack_file_name.

nodes.name: Split filter and paging
nodes.summary: getFilterAndLimitOptions copies the query into a filter, moves limit and offset into limitOptions with defaults 100 and 0, and removes them from the filter.

nodes.name: Query captures with session joins
nodes.summary: RawCaptureRepository.getByFilter selects raw_capture columns plus device_identifier, grower_account_id, wallet, user_photo_url and session.organization_id through left joins, ordered by created_at desc with limit and offset.

nodes.name: Count matching captures
nodes.summary: RawCapture.getRawCapturesCount calls the inherited BaseRepository.countByFilter, which runs COUNT on raw_capture with the same filter and parses the result as an integer.

nodes.name: Build page response with links
nodes.summary: rawCaptureGet builds prev/next links for 'raw-captures' with generatePrevAndNext and sends raw_captures, links, and the query with count.

nodes.name: Get Raw Capture by Id
nodes.summary: Returns one raw capture with its session, wallet and device fields, or HTTP 404 when the id is unknown.

nodes.name: Validate capture id
nodes.summary: rawCaptureSingleGet validates req.params with rawCaptureIdParamSchema (uuid raw_capture_id).

nodes.name: Load capture through joined filter
nodes.summary: RawCapture.getRawCaptureById runs the joined getByFilter with 'raw_capture.id' and returns the first frozen capture.

nodes.name: Return capture or 404
nodes.summary: The handler throws HttpError 404 'raw capture with <id> not found' when no capture has an id, otherwise it sends the capture.

nodes.name: Session & Track Tracking
nodes.summary: Records field data collection sessions on the /session routes and GPS track uploads on the /track routes. A session row links one device_configuration to the originating wallet_registration and carries target_wallet, check_in_photo_url, track_url, organization, start_time and bulk_pack_version; a track row links a locations_url file to a session.

businessRules: POST /session requires uuid id, device_configuration_id and originating_wallet_registration_id; bulk_pack_version must be 'v1' or 'v2'; unknown keys are rejected.
Session creation is idempotent on id: 201 for a new row with created_at now, 200 with the stored session for a repeated id.
Session list filters grower_account_id and wallet apply to wallet_registration, all other filter keys are prefixed with 'session.'.
POST /track requires a URI locations_url, a uuid session_id and bulk_pack_file_name; track creation is not idempotent and always returns 201.
GET /track/:track_id uses BaseRepository.getById, so an unknown id fails with 404 'Can not found track by id:<id>' from the repository.
session.organization_id is not accepted by POST /session; per ADR 0001 a database operator sets it from the organization string.
crossDomainInteractions: Sessions reference Device Configuration (device_configuration_id) and Wallet Registration (originating_wallet_registration_id) by foreign key and join them for device_identifier, wallet, grower_account_id and user_photo_url.
Raw Capture Ingestion requires the session before it stores a capture (409 otherwise).
The session wallet supplies the planter identifier that Legacy Database Bridging uses to find the legacy planter.

nodes.name: Create Session
nodes.summary: Stores a collection session that the app uploads before its captures, idempotent on the session id.

nodes.name: Validate session body
nodes.summary: sessionPostSchema requires uuid id, device_configuration_id and originating_wallet_registration_id, and allows target_wallet, URI check_in_photo_url and track_url, organization, ISO start_time, bulk_pack_file_name and bulk_pack_version 'v1' or 'v2'.

nodes.name: Open transaction
nodes.summary: SessionService.createSession begins a transaction on the field data Session and rolls it back on any error before it rethrows.

nodes.name: Check for existing session id
nodes.summary: SessionModel.createSession looks up the id through getSessionById, which queries the joined session view with limit 1.

nodes.name: Insert session or return existing
nodes.summary: When no session exists, the model inserts the body with created_at now and returns status 201; otherwise it returns the stored session with status 200.

nodes.name: Respond with session
nodes.summary: sessionPost sends the session with the status that the model returned.

nodes.name: List Sessions
nodes.summary: Returns a page of sessions joined with device and wallet details, with a count over the same joins and prev/next links.

nodes.name: Validate session query
nodes.summary: sessionGetQuerySchema allows filters such as id, HH:MM start_time, device_configuration_id, originating_wallet_registration_id, YYYY-MM-DD created_at, grower_account_id, organization_id arrays, device_identifier, wallet, bulk_pack_file_name, offset and limit.

nodes.name: Qualify filter columns
nodes.summary: SessionService.addTableNames maps grower_account_id and wallet to wallet_registration.<key> and every other key to session.<key>.

nodes.name: Query sessions with joins
nodes.summary: SessionRepository.getSessions selects session columns plus device_identifier, grower_account_id, wallet and user_photo_url through left joins, with limit and offset.

nodes.name: Count sessions over joins
nodes.summary: SessionRepository.countByFilter counts session rows after the same left joins, so the filter can use joined columns.

nodes.name: Build page response
nodes.summary: sessionGet builds prev/next links for 'session' and sends sessions, links and the query with count.

nodes.name: Get Session by Id
nodes.summary: Returns one session with device and wallet details, or HTTP 404.

nodes.name: Validate session id
nodes.summary: sessionSingleGet validates req.params with sessionIdParamSchema (uuid session_id).

nodes.name: Load session by id
nodes.summary: SessionModel.getSessionById queries the joined session view on 'session.id' with limit 1 and returns the first frozen session.

nodes.name: Return session or 404
nodes.summary: The handler throws HttpError 404 'session with <id> not found' when the result has no id, otherwise it sends the session.

nodes.name: Record Track
nodes.summary: Stores a reference to an uploaded GPS track file (locations_url) for a session and bulk pack.

nodes.name: Validate track body
nodes.summary: trackPostSchema requires a URI locations_url, a uuid session_id and a bulk_pack_file_name string, and rejects unknown keys.

nodes.name: Insert track in transaction
nodes.summary: TrackService.createTrack begins a transaction, calls Track.createTrack (a plain BaseRepository create on the track table, with no existence check), commits, and rolls back on error.

nodes.name: Respond 201
nodes.summary: trackPost always sends the inserted track row with HTTP 201.

nodes.name: List Tracks
nodes.summary: Returns a page of tracks filtered by session_id or bulk_pack_file_name, with a count and prev/next links.

nodes.name: Validate track query
nodes.summary: trackGetQuerySchema allows offset (>= 0), limit (> 0), bulk_pack_file_name and a uuid session_id.

nodes.name: Load tracks and count
nodes.summary: trackGet splits the filter and paging, then reads Track.getTracks (BaseRepository.getByFilter mapped to the five public fields) and getTracksCount.

nodes.name: Build page response
nodes.summary: trackGet builds prev/next links for 'track' and sends tracks, links and the query with count.

nodes.name: Get Track by Id
nodes.summary: Returns one track row; an unknown id fails with HTTP 404 from the repository.

nodes.name: Validate track id
nodes.summary: trackSingleGet validates req.params with trackIdParamSchema (uuid track_id).

nodes.name: Load track by id
nodes.summary: Track.getTrackById calls BaseRepository.getById, which throws HttpError 404 'Can not found track by id:<id>' when no row matches; the handler's own 404 check is therefore not reached for unknown ids.

nodes.name: Send track
nodes.summary: The handler sends the raw track row.

nodes.name: Device Configuration
nodes.summary: Stores the phone and app build that a grower used, as rows in the device_configuration table on the /device-configuration routes. Sessions reference these rows, and capture and session reads join them for device_identifier.

businessRules: POST /device-configuration requires uuid id, device_identifier, brand, model, device, hardware, manufacturer, app_build, app_version, os_version, sdk_version and an ISO logged_at; serial may be empty or null; unknown keys are rejected.
Creation is idempotent on id: 201 for a new row with created_at now, 200 with the stored row for a repeated id.
GET /device-configuration accepts only offset, limit and bulk_pack_file_name.
crossDomainInteractions: Session & Track Tracking references device_configuration.id from session.device_configuration_id.
Raw Capture Ingestion and session reads join device_configuration for device_identifier, which the legacy trees row also stores.

nodes.name: Register Device Configuration
nodes.summary: Stores the device and app details that the app sends, idempotent on the configuration id.

nodes.name: Validate device body
nodes.summary: deviceConfigurationPostSchema requires the uuid id, the device and app build fields and an ISO logged_at, allows an empty serial and an optional bulk_pack_file_name, and rejects unknown keys.

nodes.name: Open transaction
nodes.summary: DeviceConfigurationService.createDeviceConfiguration begins a transaction on the field data Session, commits after the model call, and rolls back on error.

nodes.name: Insert device configuration or return existing
nodes.summary: DeviceConfiguration.createDeviceConfiguration looks up the id; it inserts the row with created_at now and returns 201, or returns the stored row with 200.

nodes.name: Respond with device configuration
nodes.summary: deviceConfigurationPost sends the record as JSON with the status from the model.

nodes.name: List Device Configurations
nodes.summary: Returns a page of device configurations filtered by bulk_pack_file_name, with a count and prev/next links.

nodes.name: Validate device query
nodes.summary: deviceConfigurationGetQuerySchema allows offset (>= 0), limit (> 0) and bulk_pack_file_name.

nodes.name: Load page and count
nodes.summary: The model reads rows through BaseRepository.getByFilter, freezes the 15 device fields plus created_at, and counts with countByFilter.

nodes.name: Build page response
nodes.summary: deviceConfigurationGet builds prev/next links for 'device-configuration' and sends device_configurations, links and the query with count.

nodes.name: Get Device Configuration by Id
nodes.summary: Returns one device configuration or HTTP 404.

nodes.name: Validate device configuration id
nodes.summary: deviceConfigurationSingleGet validates the uuid device_configuration_id path parameter.

nodes.name: Load by id
nodes.summary: DeviceConfiguration.getDeviceConfigurationById filters on id and returns the first frozen row.

nodes.name: Return record or 404
nodes.summary: The handler throws HttpError 404 'device configuration with <id> not found' when no record has an id.

nodes.name: Wallet Registration
nodes.summary: Stores grower wallet registrations made on a device in the wallet_registration table on the /wallet-registration routes: wallet, grower_account_id, names, phone or email, user_photo_url, location and registered_at. A session names its originating wallet registration, and the wallet value identifies the legacy planter.

businessRules: POST /wallet-registration requires uuid id and grower_account_id, wallet, URI user_photo_url, first_name, last_name, and lat -90..90 and lon -180..180; email must match /.*@.*/.
Either phone or email is required (HTTP 422 'Either phone or email is required').
Creation is idempotent on id: 201 for a new row, 200 with the stored row for a repeated id; the model does not set created_at (the column default does).
GET /wallet-registration accepts only offset, limit and bulk_pack_file_name.
crossDomainInteractions: Session & Track Tracking references wallet_registration.id from session.originating_wallet_registration_id and joins it for wallet and grower_account_id.
Legacy Database Bridging matches the wallet against legacy planter phone or email, and its ETL scripts backfill wallet_registration from legacy planter_registrations.

nodes.name: Register Wallet
nodes.summary: Stores a grower wallet registration from the app, idempotent on the registration id.

nodes.name: Validate registration body
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationPostSchema requires the uuid id and grower_account_id, wallet, URI user_photo_url, names and bounded lat and lon; phone and email are nullable; registered_at, v1_legacy_organization and bulk_pack_file_name are optional.

nodes.name: Require phone or email
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationPost throws HttpError 422 'Either phone or email is required' when both are absent.

nodes.name: Open transaction
nodes.summary: WalletRegistrationService.createWalletRegistration begins a transaction on the field data Session, commits after the model call, and rolls back on error.

nodes.name: Insert registration or return existing
nodes.summary: WalletRegistration.createWalletRegistration looks up the id; it inserts the body and returns 201, or returns the stored registration with 200.

nodes.name: Respond with registration
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationPost sends the frozen registration as JSON with the status from the model.

nodes.name: List Wallet Registrations
nodes.summary: Returns a page of wallet registrations filtered by bulk_pack_file_name, with a count and prev/next links.

nodes.name: Validate registration query
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationGetQuerySchema allows offset (>= 0), limit (> 0) and bulk_pack_file_name.

nodes.name: Load page and count
nodes.summary: The model reads rows through BaseRepository.getByFilter, keeps the 13 public registration fields, and counts with countByFilter.

nodes.name: Build page response
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationGet builds prev/next links for 'wallet-registration' and sends wallet_registrations, links and the query with count.

nodes.name: Get Wallet Registration by Id
nodes.summary: Returns one wallet registration or HTTP 404.

nodes.name: Validate registration id
nodes.summary: walletRegistrationSingleGet validates the uuid wallet_registration_id path parameter.

nodes.name: Load by id
nodes.summary: WalletRegistration.getWalletRegistrationById filters on id and returns the first frozen registration.

nodes.name: Return registration or 404
nodes.summary: The handler throws HttpError 404 'wallet registration with <id> not found' when no record has an id.

nodes.name: Legacy Database Bridging
nodes.summary: Keeps the legacy treetracker database in step with field data during the monolith migration. At runtime it writes a trees row (and tree_attributes rows when given) for each new capture through a second Knex client on DATABASE_URL_LEGACYDB, and rejects legacy trees through the legacy admin API. One-off ETL scripts in database/etl backfill trees.session_id and field_data.wallet_registration from legacy data.

businessRules: A legacy planter whose phone or email equals the session wallet must exist; otherwise the capture upload fails with HTTP 422 'Legacy planter has not been created for the legacy tree'.
The legacy trees row is idempotent on uuid (the lowercased capture id): an existing row is reused.
estimated_geometric_location is set with ST_PointFromText('POINT(lon lat)', 4326).
time_created and time_updated of the legacy tree both take captured_at.
Legacy rejection sets approved false and active false through the admin API, scoped to /organization/<id>/ when organization_id is given.
A legacy session id is uuid-by-string(device_identifier + planter_identifier).
crossDomainInteractions: Raw Capture Ingestion calls this domain on POST /raw-captures and on PATCH /raw-captures/:raw_capture_id/reject.
Uses the wallet from Wallet Registration (via the session join) as planter_identifier.
The wallet registration ETL inserts rows into Wallet Registration, with id set to the legacy trees.session_id.

nodes.name: Mirror Capture to Legacy Trees
nodes.summary: Builds and writes the legacy trees row for a new capture inside the LegacySession transaction that RawCaptureService opens; its id becomes raw_capture.reference_id.

nodes.name: Bind legacy database session
nodes.summary: LegacySession is a BaseSession bound to knexLegacyDB, the Knex client for DATABASE_URL_LEGACYDB, so the legacy repositories share one legacy transaction.

nodes.name: Find legacy planter by wallet
nodes.summary: LegacyPlanterRepository.findUser selects the first planter row where phone or email equals the wallet.

nodes.name: Build legacy trees row
nodes.summary: LegacyTree.legacyTree throws HttpError 422 when no planter exists; otherwise it returns a frozen row with lowercased uuid, image_url, lat, lon, planter_id, planter_identifier (wallet), planter_photo_url, device_identifier, note, and time_created and time_updated set to captured_at.

nodes.name: Reuse existing legacy tree
nodes.summary: createTreesInLegacyDB returns the existing trees row when one with the same uuid exists.

nodes.name: Insert legacy tree with geometry
nodes.summary: LegacyTreeRepository.create runs a raw INSERT into trees with estimated_geometric_location = ST_PointFromText('POINT(lon lat)', 4326) and returns the new id.

nodes.name: Insert tree attributes
nodes.summary: When attributes are given, the model inserts them into tree_attributes with tree_id set to the new tree id. POST /raw-captures deletes extra_attributes first, so this list is empty for API uploads.

nodes.name: Backfill Legacy Session Ids
nodes.summary: One-off script that sets trees.session_id on active legacy trees from the device and planter identifiers.

nodes.name: Connect to database
nodes.summary: The script creates its own Knex pg client on DATABASE_URL with a pool of 0 to 4.

nodes.name: Select trees without session id
nodes.summary: It selects up to 1000 trees rows that are active, have a null session_id, and have a device_identifier and planter_identifier.

nodes.name: Derive session uuid
nodes.summary: For each row it computes the session id as uuid-by-string(device_identifier + planter_identifier); make-legacy-session-id.js logs the same derivation for one hard-coded pair.

nodes.name: Update tree session id
nodes.summary: It updates trees.session_id for the row id. The outer loop condition (j < 500 with a constant j) never changes, so the script repeats batches until it is stopped.

nodes.name: Backfill Wallet Registrations from Legacy
nodes.summary: One-off SQL that creates field_data.wallet_registration rows from legacy planter_registrations, the latest planter photo and session_id in trees, and treetracker.grower_account.

nodes.name: Pick latest planter photo and session
nodes.summary: A subquery takes, per planter_id, the newest active trees row with a session_id and keeps its planter_photo_url and session_id (the first script version does not require active = true).

nodes.name: Join grower account by wallet
nodes.summary: It joins treetracker.grower_account where wallet equals COALESCE(phone, email) of the planter registration.

nodes.name: Filter and remove duplicates
nodes.summary: It keeps registrations with a phone or email and a lat and lon, skips session ids that already exist in field_data.wallet_registration, and keeps one row per wallet with DISTINCT ON.

nodes.name: Insert wallet registrations
nodes.summary: It inserts id (the legacy session_id), wallet, user_photo_url (or 'none'), grower_account_id, names, phone, email, lat, lon, registered_at and v1_legacy_organization into field_data.wallet_registration.

nodes.name: Schema Migrations & Seed Data
nodes.summary: Defines and evolves the field data schema with db-migrate (46 up and down SQL files under database/migrations/sqls) and fills development databases with Knex seeds. The domainEvents migrations create the domain_event table, LIST-partitioned by status, with domain_event_sent and domain_event_handled yearly partitions up to 2026; no runtime code under server/ reads or writes these tables. session_segment and the raw_capture root and root_check_processed_at columns also exist only in the schema at this commit.

businessRules: Each migration JavaScript file reads its sqls/<name>-up.sql or -down.sql file and runs it with db.runSql.
The domain_event tables (domain_event_raised, domain_event_received, domain_event_sent_2021..2026, domain_event_handled_2021..2026) are created by migrations but not written by runtime code.
In Kubernetes, migrations run as an Argo CD PostSync Job with DATABASE_URL from the database-migration-connection secret; in CI, npm run db-migrate-ci runs them.
Seeds run in file order 00 to 04 with NODE_ENV development or usertest and DATABASE_URL_SEEDER, and they also write the legacy planter and trees tables.
crossDomainInteractions: Creates the tables that Raw Capture Ingestion, Session & Track Tracking, Device Configuration and Wallet Registration read and write.
The raw capture seed writes legacy planter and trees rows the same way that Legacy Database Bridging links them through reference_id.

nodes.name: Apply Schema Migrations
nodes.summary: Runs pending db-migrate migrations against the field data schema in CI, locally, and on each Argo CD sync.

domainMeta.entryPoint: npm run db-migrate-ci / database-migration-job (Argo CD PostSync)

nodes.name: Run db-migrate up
nodes.summary: The database-migration-job runs node_modules/db-migrate/bin/db-migrate up --migrations-dir database/migrations/ in the service image as an Argo CD PostSync hook with backoffLimit 1.

nodes.name: Load and run migration SQL
nodes.summary: Each migration up() reads sqls/<name>-up.sql with fs.readFile, logs it, and passes it to db.runSql; down() does the same with the -down.sql file.

nodes.name: Create raw_capture table
nodes.summary: The first migration creates raw_capture with reference_id, image_url, lat, lon, status and rejection_reason, plus status and date indexes; later migrations reshape it for bulk packs and sessions.

nodes.name: Create session and track tables
nodes.summary: The session migration creates session with foreign keys to device_configuration and wallet_registration; a later migration creates track with session_id, locations_url and bulk_pack_file_name.

nodes.name: Create unused domain_event partitions
nodes.summary: The domainEvents migration creates domain_event partitioned by status into raised, received, sent and handled, with yearly sent and handled partitions; 20240105095545 adds 2024 to 2026. No server code writes these tables.

nodes.name: Add session_segment and root columns
nodes.summary: Later migrations add the session_segment table with a PostGIS convex_hull and raw_capture.session_segment_id, session.processed_at, and raw_capture.root and root_check_processed_at; no server code reads them yet.

nodes.name: Seed Development Data
nodes.summary: Fills a development or user-test database with device configurations, wallet registrations, sessions and about 13,500 raw captures with matching legacy trees.

domainMeta.entryPoint: npm run seed-dev / npm run seed-usertest (knex seed:run)

nodes.name: Clean seeded tables
nodes.summary: 00_job_database_cleaner deletes all raw_capture, session, wallet_registration and device_configuration rows, then the planter rows of the seeded grower accounts and their trees rows.

nodes.name: Seed device configurations
nodes.summary: 01_table_device_configuration inserts 100 rows with fixed ids and random Chance strings for the device and app fields.

nodes.name: Seed wallet registrations
nodes.summary: 02_table_wallet_registration inserts 100 rows, each copied from a random grower account, with email set to the wallet.

nodes.name: Seed sessions
nodes.summary: 03_table_session inserts 100 sessions that pair device configuration i with wallet registration i.

nodes.name: Seed raw captures with legacy trees
nodes.summary: 04_table_raw_capture creates a planter for the grower account when none exists, then in one CTE inserts a trees row and a raw_capture row with reference_id = the new tree id and status 'unprocessed', for each capture-match record.

edges.description: POST /raw-captures loads the session by session_id (409 when missing) and uses its wallet, device_identifier and user_photo_url; capture reads join session for organization_id.
Capture upload writes a legacy trees row whose id becomes raw_capture.reference_id; capture rejection patches that legacy tree through the legacy admin API.
session.device_configuration_id references device_configuration.id; session and capture reads join it for device_identifier.
session.originating_wallet_registration_id references wallet_registration.id; session and capture reads join it for wallet, grower_account_id and user_photo_url.
The wallet is the planter identifier for the legacy planter lookup; the ETL SQL backfills wallet_registration rows from legacy planter_registrations.
Migrations create and reshape raw_capture; the seeds load raw captures with legacy trees and reference_id.
Migrations create session, track and session_segment; the seeds insert 100 sessions.
